subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus focused predicate retry tests as sufficient proof for this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content recovery, given the code-less provider rotation error is not client-inducible on demand?
rationale: The normal external-PR proof gate asks for after-fix real behavior output, but the author plausibly explains that the exact provider-side key or snapshot rotation cannot be forced without waiting for an organic event.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the production logs, existing bounded retry machinery, and positive/negative tests as enough for this non-inducible provider error and proceed with ordinary merge review.

options.title: Wait for organic proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until an xAI rotation naturally occurs and the contributor can attach redacted after-fix gateway logs.

options.title: Require maintainer live validation
options.body: Ask a maintainer with xAI access to validate the closest feasible live stale-reasoning scenario before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the production logs, existing bounded retry machinery, and positive/negative tests as enough for this non-inducible provider error and proceed with ordinary merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior same-predicate retry work and proof pattern were authored and merged by this person, making them the best available routing candidate for whether this proof shape is acceptable.
